answer: Implementing a jade liquidity lockup, the protocol utilizes quadratic slashing penalties to anchor the cost of identity replication to the square of the total staked volume. This creates a regime where the marginal expenditure required to deploy a sable cluster of Sybil nodes scales super-linearly relative to the underlying asset value. Such hyper-scaling ensures the economic security threshold sustains a robust Nash equilibrium by making the expected utility of consensus manipulation strictly negative through prohibitive capital commitments.
